retrievalProfile.description: A warm, desaturated sepia portrait of a man against a weathered wooden texture with classic serif typography in the lower-left corner.

recipe.visualDefinition: A tight, intimate portrait of a man with stubble and dark hair, positioned on the right side of the frame. The background features vertical, heavily textured weathered wood on the left. The entire image is processed in a warm, low-saturation sepia tone with high contrast, emphasizing skin texture and wood grain. Typography is anchored in the bottom left, using a mix of bold and light serif fonts.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject's face occupies the right two-thirds of the frame
Weathered wood texture provides vertical rhythm on the left
Typography is nested in the dark area of the subject's shoulder
High-contrast lighting creates deep shadows in the clothing and hair

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large-scale close-up portrait shifted to the right, with the face filling the upper right quadrant.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes and the bright white shirt collar providing a central point of light.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the subject's eyes, down the line of the nose to the white collar, then leftward to the typography.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The dark jacket and the shadowed wood texture serve as functional negative space for text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep brown and charcoal (shadows and jacket)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with high value contrast between the dark jacket and light skin/shirt.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between bold uppercase display and light lowercase subtitle within the same serif family.
graphicDevices: Horizontal rule separating subtitle from display text

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary classical serif weight and sharp terminals.
Excellent for the lighter, lowercase subtitle text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a close-up portrait of a man with stubble and dark hair, looking slightly off-camera, positioned on the right. Background on the left is vertical weathered wood. Apply a warm sepia filter with high contrast and film grain.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of text in the bottom left corner. Top line: large, bold, all-caps serif font. Bottom line: smaller, light, lowercase serif font. Color should be a warm cream.

verificationChecks: Is the wood texture visible on the left?
Is the text aligned to the bottom left?

adjustableVariables: Font weight of the primary name
mustRedesign: Avoid any modern digital interface elements
Ensure the text does not obscure the subject's face

mustAchieve: Natural skin tones within the sepia range

postGenerationChecks: Check for high-contrast lighting on the face
Verify the vertical orientation of the wood grain
Ensure the white collar provides a strong highlight
Confirm the typography is in a serif style
recipe.reuseFormula: Portrait(Subject:Man, Style:Sepia, Lighting:High-Contrast) + Background(Texture:Weathered Wood) + Typography(Position:Bottom-Left, Style:Stacked Serif)
